name: walkable-3d
title_zh: 照片、草图、户型图，都能走进去的 Three.js
tagline_zh: 丢一张照片或随手画几笔，就生成能 WASD 走动的完整 3D 场景；导出 .glb 时每个物体还带着名字。
tagline_en: Drop a photo or rough sketch, get a walkable Three.js scene with WASD controls; export .glb with named, separable.
desc_en: Build a real, walkable 3D scene from a prompt, a photo, a floor plan, or a 2D sketch — as a self-contained Three.js page you can walk with WASD, then export to .glb with every object still named and separable for Blender or Unreal. Use whenever someone asks for a 3D scene, a 3D model of a place, a house or room or city block or level you can walk around in, "make this photo into 3D", "turn this sk
why_zh: 不是贴图骗眼睛，是真几何体：每个物件独立命名、可分离，导出后能继续编辑。从二维输入到三维可走场景。
why_en: Real geometry, not flat textures: every object is named and separable, so the .glb export stays editable. One pipeline from 2D.
limit_zh: 只认单张图片或简单草图，复杂多视角照片重建会失真；生成的是静态场景，不含动画、物理或交互逻辑。
limit_en: Single image or simple sketch only; complex multi-view photos lose fidelity. Static scene only—no animation, physics, or interaction. Materials need.
title_en: Walk into a 3D scene from photo, sketch, or floor plan
